SELECT SUM("jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers"."lifetime_spend_pretax") / SUM("jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers"."count_lifetime_orders") AS average_order_value
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers"
WHERE "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers"."first_ordered_at" >= '2024-01-01'
  AND "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers"."first_ordered_at" < '2025-01-01';
